    AI Overview
    In the 500th episode of NCIS (Season 23, Episode 14, "All Good Things," aired March 24, 2026), Director Leon Vance (played by Rocky Carroll) was killed in the line of duty. Vance was shot multiple times in the chest by a corrupt CID agent while successfully saving the NCIS agency from being dismantled. 
    Key Details About Vance's Death: 
    • The Cause: After a tense investigation, Vance was betrayed and fatally shot by CID Agent Dolan Thompson, who was part of a smuggling ring.
    • Heroic Sacrifice: Vance died while preventing the complete closure of NCIS, making his death a "final act" of service.
    • The Aftermath: Following the shooting, a symbolic scene occurred where a young version of Donald "Ducky" Mallard (Adam Campbell) appeared to help guide Vance, confirming his death.
    • Departure: This marked the end of Rocky Carroll’s 18-season run as a series regular on the show.
    • Continued Role: Although his character is dead, Rocky Carroll is expected to continue directing future episodes of the series. 
    NCIS honored the character's long tenure with a storyline that served as a "love letter" to his impact on the agency.

    AI Overview
    Yes, Director Leon Vance (played by Rocky Carroll) leaves NCIS in the 500th episode (Season 23), titled "All Good Things." Vance is killed in the line of duty after being shot by a corrupt agent. 
    Key Details regarding the exit: 
    • Final Episode: The character dies in the milestone 500th episode aired in March 2026.
    • The Exit: Vance sacrifices himself to save the agency from a conspiracy, ending Rocky Carroll's 18-season run on the show.
    • Future Return: While his time as a series regular has ended, Carroll confirmed in a TVLine interview
      and a Variety interview that he plans to return to direct future episodes.
    • Reaction: Carroll stated in an Instagram post that he was content with the "definitive and powerful send-off".
